description: This file defines the NewtonRaphson class, which implements the Newton-Raphson root-finding algorithm with iterative refinement and bisection fallback, used for statistical calculations within PHPSpreadsheet's distribution functions.

classes.name: NewtonRaphson
classes.description: A class implementing the Newton-Raphson method for finding roots of functions with fallback to bisection for stability.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NewtonRaphson object with a callable function to evaluate.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the root-finding algorithm for a given probability, returning either a float approximation or an error reference.
